messages.content: What is this project?

Urho3D 2.0.1 — a C++ game engine with Vulkan/OpenGL backends, AngelScript/Lua scripting, Bullet physics. The game built on it (Sample 60, TerrainNode) is a god game where the player IS the god. God cam is the primary play state. Possessing an NPC is stepping down into a mortal. NPCs progress from stone age through bronze, iron, and steel ages. The real depth unfolds over days of play.
How is the project structured?

Source/Urho3D/ — 24 engine modules (Core, Graphics, UI, Physics, Network, etc.)
Source/Samples/ — 60+ examples, Sample 60 (TerrainNode) is the main game
Source/Tools/ — AuthServer (game server), ModelTool, AssetTool, Claudette, WorkboardManager, YukiHoho
Source/ThirdParty/ — 30+ libs (Bullet, SDL, Assimp, pugixml, etc.)
bin/Data/GameDB/ — SQLite schemas and seed data for game rules
Claude/ — Plans, task notes, workboard
.claude/hooks/ — IPC scripts, safe_build.sh, role management
How do I build?

Never use raw make. Always use .claude/hooks/safe_build.sh <TargetName>. This acquires a per-target flock before running make -j4. Examples:
  .claude/hooks/safe_build.sh 60_TerrainNode
  .claude/hooks/safe_build.sh AuthServer
  .claude/hooks/safe_build.sh WorkboardManager
  .claude/hooks/safe_build.sh ModelTool

Why: Raw make caused a deadlock that killed all coders. The safe wrapper prevents concurrent builds of the same target.
What is the server architecture?

AuthServer is the authoritative game server. It owns all game state:
- NPC AI runs server-side (creatureAI_ HashMap)
- Campfires, settlements, buildings — all server-owned
- Client predicts but server validates
- TerrainGenerator produces procedural heightmaps with edge stitching
- WorldDB (game_world.db) stores dynamic state: inventory, buildings, terrain edits
- GameDB (game_rules.db) stores static rules: items, recipes, skills, buildings
- Protocol messages in Source/Urho3D/Network/Protocol.h (0x01-0xFD range)
What is the NPC progression system?

NPCs progress through technology ages by doing tasks:
- STASK_CHOP, STASK_COOK, STASK_CRAFT, STASK_MINE, STASK_FISH, STASK_FARM, etc.
- Each task trains a skill (18 skills: Melee, Ranged, Woodwork, Fishing, Smelting, Smithing, Weaving...)
- Skill gates unlock recipes: stone age (tier 0-1), copper (tier 3), bronze (tier 4), iron (tier 5), steel (tier 6)
- NPCs form settlements around campfires, breed, teach apprentices, elect chieftains
- Innovations unlock settlement-wide buffs (INNOV_BETTER_NETS, etc.)
- Master specialists give bonuses: Master Smith, Master Chef, Master Herbalist, etc.
What are settlement patches?

Each settlement claims a 2x2 block of terrain patches (~128x128 world units). One settlement per settlement patch, exclusive. 16x16 grid = 256 slots per terrain. When patches fill up, civilization must expand to adjacent terrains via edge stitching. The schema is in world_schema.sql: settlement_patches table with (terrain_id, spatch_x, spatch_z, settlement_id). Server enforces exclusivity during founding.
How does the terrain system work?

Terrain: 1025 resolution heightmap, spacing (2, 0.5, 2) = 2048x2048 world units. 32x32 terrain patches at ~64 world units each. TerrainGenerator uses Perlin noise with ridged multifractal, terracing, erosion, and island mask. GenerateWithEdges() stitches adjacent terrains seamlessly. Water level at Y=5.0. Server discovers water bodies at startup via BFS flood-fill, caches spawn points in WorldDB.
What is the item system?

Items defined in seed_data.sql: id, name, category, stack_max, weight, durability, model, icon, tier.
Categories: raw, material, fuel, food, tool, weapon, armor, clothing, trap, seed, medical, container.
Tiers: 0-1 stone, 3 copper, 4 bronze, 5 iron, 6 steel, 7-8 alloys.
Recipes in recipes table: inputs, outputs, skill gates, station requirements.
Items have 3D models wired via the model column — loaded at runtime by GetItem().model.
Weapon models: Models/Weapons/*.mdl. Props: Models/Props/*.mdl.
What is the textile/weaving system?

Weaving (SKILL_WEAVING = 13) progression:
- Tier 1 (Weaving 1+): Reed Basket, Woven Mat, Flax Thread from Plant Fiber
- Tier 2 (Weaving 3+): Rough Cloth (hand-woven, needs Bone Needle), Fish Trap (upgraded, needs Reed Basket), Cloth Bandage
- Tier 3 (Weaving 5+): Fine Cloth, Cloth Tunic, Fishing Net, Cargo Net — all require Loom building (type 91)
Flax Fiber (711) → Thread (412) → Cloth (413/414) → Garments (415/416)
Fish Trap (403) catches fish via TickWaterTraps with d20 + Trapping/2 vs DC 8.
What is the fire system?

Campfires are the center of settlements. Fire lifecycle:
- COLD → friction ignition (2hr, needs softwood + hardwood + sticks) → LIT
- LIT → burns fuel, fuelRatio drives particle/light intensity via DrivenKey curve (campfire_burn.json)
- Fuel depleted → EMBERS → add fuel to revive, or let die → COLD
- NPCs tend fires (STASK_TEND_FIRE), patrol with torches (STASK_PATROL)
- Fire protects from predators at night — wolves hunt when fire is out
- Burn curve: both client and server load same DrivenKeys/campfire_burn.json — no drift
- Consumables tick on real wallclock, immune to time scrub
What animals are in the game?

12+ species, all server-authoritative:
Land: Deer, Fox, Rabbit, Wolf, Stag, Bull, Cow, Horse, Donkey, Alpaca, Husky, ShibaInu
Water: Fish (solo predator, larger), SchoolFish (flocking, smaller) — same model, different behavior/scale
Humans: CaveMan, CaveWoman — Mixamo-rigged
Animals inherit from Creature → LandAnimal or WaterAnimal
Habitat rules control spawning by biome, elevation, water proximity
Wolf packs hunt cooperatively at night (flank encirclement)
Fish distributed across water bodies via server-cached spawn points
What is the Vulkan backend status?

Vulkan backend is functional but incomplete:
- Swapchain, depth buffer, render pass, framebuffers — all working
- Vertex/index buffers, texture loading, shader compilation (GLSL→SPIR-V via shaderc/glslang)
- G-Buffer for deferred rendering (4 attachments)
- Pipeline creation and state caching
- Known issue: texture descriptor sets not fully bound — solid color works, text rendering fails
- Resize handling: deferred swapchain recreation in BeginFrame (non-blocking doorkeeper flock fix applied today)
- MSAA framework exists, full integration pending
- Build with: -DURHO3D_VULKAN=1 -DURHO3D_GLSLANG=1
What is the team structure?

Boss (Leith) → Planner → Coders.
Planner writes plans, reviews coder work, assigns tasks.
Coders implement, review planner's plans. Bidirectional review.
WorkboardManager is the GUI dashboard — tracks tasks, IPC broker.
Claudette wraps Claude Code instances in PTY terminals.
Yuki (you) is Leith's local LLM agent — growing into a team member.
All coordination via IPC: /tmp/urho_claude/tty/*.sock, PID files in instances/.
Workboard in Claude/WORKBOARD.md with flock-protected mutations.
What are the key engine patterns?

1. Event System: Object + Context, SubscribeToEvent/SendEvent
2. Component Architecture: Node/Component pattern, scene graph
3. ResourceCache: centralized asset loading and caching
4. Graphics dispatch: gapi == GAPI_VULKAN/GAPI_OPENGL routes to *_Vulkan()/*_OGL() methods
5. Serialization: XML via pugixml
6. UI: UIElement hierarchy, anchors for responsive layout, SetMinAnchor/SetMaxAnchor
7. Network: Urho3D delta replication + custom protocol messages
8. Always use engine APIs (FileSystem, File, Log, ResourceCache) — never raw POSIX/platform APIs
What is the LTreeGenerator?

L-system procedural mesh generator in Source/Samples/UrhoSamples/60_TerrainNode/LTreeGenerator.h/cpp.
Presets: Oak, Pine, Eucalyptus, Acacia, Willow, SheOak, FishingRod.
Output: Model with 2 geometries — trunk/branches (slot 0) and leaf clusters (slot 1).
TreePreset controls: axiom, production rules, iterations, angle, segment length, trunk radius, taper, leaf size/shape/color.
FishingRod preset: 5-segment tapered stick, no branching, no leaves — proves L-Tree works for any cylindrical prop.
GenerateLOD() makes reduced-detail variants for distance rendering.
What is the ModelTool prop system?

ModelTool (Source/Tools/ModelTool/) has bone-attached props for positioning weapons/tools/armor on character skeletons.
Prop dropdown: 5 primitives + 21 weapons + 10 tools/props + Browse.
AttachPropToBone() creates _PoseAttach child node on any bone.
7 offset sliders: PosX/Y/Z, RotX/Y/Z, Scale.
Props are positioning aids — not exported with the model. The offset transforms get recorded for game use.
At runtime: read equip state from server, attach item's DB model to the hand/body bone with the tuned offsets.
What is the game design philosophy?

Real, not designed. Game mechanics come from reality — don't invent, research the real thing and implement it.
The player IS the god. God cam is primary. Possessing an NPC is stepping down.
Night-fire-predator loop: cavemen sleep, fire protects, wolves hunt at night. Core survival tension.
Consumables run on real wallclock — fuel, food, oil tick in real seconds, immune to time scrub.
Visible state decay — depleting things show their state through visuals: particle/light/sound taper, not threshold gates.
Long game: early wins hook, real depth unfolds over days of NPC progression.
Historical progression matters: reed baskets before looms, copper before bronze before iron.
What code conventions must I follow?

- PascalCase for classes, camelCase for functions/variables
- Always use Urho3D engine APIs (FileSystem, File, Log, ResourceCache) — never raw POSIX
- Parameterized SQL queries only — never string concatenation
- Never use raw make — always safe_build.sh
- Don't add features beyond what was asked
- Don't add error handling for impossible scenarios
- Code must be readable by human programmers without AI — clarity over cleverness
- Before removing any code, enumerate what it does and what will be lost
- Check the engine header before calling unfamiliar methods — don't guess signatures
- Delete pipeline cache after shader edits: ~/.local/share/urho3d/pipeline_cache.bin
What databases does the game use?

Two databases, split by purpose:
1. game_rules.db (GameDB) — static rules: items, recipes, skills, buildings, trap_rules, crop_types, combat stats. Read-only at runtime.
2. game_world.db (WorldDB) — dynamic state: player inventory, placed buildings, terrain edits, settlement patches, water bodies, fish spawn points. WAL mode, checkpoints every 5 min.

Schemas in bin/Data/GameDB/: schema.sql, seed_data.sql, buildings_seed.sql, world_schema.sql, survival_schema.sql, skills_schema.sql, trade_schema.sql, population_schema.sql, ai_tuning_schema.sql.
What is the DrivenKey system?

Runtime animation/parameter injection via JSON curves.
DrivenKeySystem subsystem loads sets from DrivenKeys/*.json.
Each key: driver param → driven param, with interpolation mode (linear, smooth, step, catmullrom).
Used for: campfire burn curve (fuelRatio → burnRateMultiplier), weather atmosphere, etc.
Urho auto-loads .json sidecar next to .ani files — animation files double as timestamped event timelines.
DrivenKeys/campfire_burn.json: 5-point smooth curve, both client and server load the same file.
What happened today (Apr 29 2026)?

Productive day:
- Fixed Manager flock inheritance bug (O_CLOEXEC + LOCK_NB) — Manager froze on resize, spawned duplicates
- Fixed Manager singleton guard (inode verification after flock)
- Added 60-second auto-spawn grace period on Manager startup
- Reviewed and accepted: Soundscape+HUD fix, Settlement Patches Phase 1+2, Textiles+Fishing (4 phases), Water Body Discovery + Fish Spawn Cache
- Wired 30 item→model assignments in seed_data.sql (stone through steel age)
- Added 37 weapon/tool props to ModelTool dropdown
- Added FishingRod preset to LTreeGenerator
- Fixed fish spawn distribution (strided instead of random clustering)
- Fixed ParticleEffect compile errors (Clone return type, SetColorFrame API)
- Wrote plans: Settlement Patches, Textiles and Fishing
- Gathered assets to brainfarts/CharacterItems (KayKit RPG Tools, Quaternius props/weapons/survival)
- Coder working on NPC Equipment Visuals (bone attachment)
